name: input-otp
title: Input OTP
description: A one-time code in square 32px cells, Geist Mono digits, the cell being typed into edged in ink.
use_for: Codes from a sign-in email or an authenticator app.
never: Cells that move focus on their own: it is one field
source: New in Conare's style: the field's hairline and ink focus (console2.css .v2-input), Geist Mono for codes
body: One real input sits over the cells, so typing, paste, delete and the phone's code suggestion (`autocomplete="one-time-code"`) work as in any field. `length` sets the cells (6), `split` puts a gap after that many, `numeric` keeps digits only. It emits `complete` with the code once full. `invalid` edges every cell in red; say what is wrong under it. Cells are 40px on phones.
